A humanoid anthropomorphic rabbit with fluffy, snow-white fur and long, erect ears. The eyes are small, beady, and deep crimson with a sinister expression. The build is lean and agile, featuring three sharp claws on each hand and a short, fluffy white cotton-ball tail. The outfit consists of a formal black tuxedo jacket with a crisp white shirt and a red bowtie.
BODY COLOR: snow-white
